description: This file implements the <calculate> element as a class within a mini-language framework. It provides functionality for calculating numerical expressions, supporting multiple data types and sub-operations like addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division. The class is part of the org.apache.ofbiz.minilang.method.otherops package and relies on various utility classes for XML handling and value expansion.

classes.name: Calculate
classes.description: Implements a mini-language calculate operation, supporting various arithmetic actions and data types.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Performs the calculation operation, determining rounding modes and formats, and updates the specified environment map with the result.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the calculate operation for debugging or logging.

inner_classes.name: SubCalc
inner_classes.description: Interface for sub-elements (<calcop> and <number>) defining how to calculate partial values.

inner_classes.name: CalcOp
inner_classes.description: Represents a calculation operator (<calcop>) supporting addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, and negation.

methods.name: calcValue
methods.description: Calculates the value of this operator with its sub-elements.

inner_classes.name: NumberOp
inner_classes.description: Represents a number element, converting a string value into a BigDecimal for calculations.

methods.name: calcValue
methods.description: Returns the BigDecimal value of the number element after expansion and parsing.

inner_classes.name: InvalidOp
inner_classes.description: A placeholder for invalid sub-elements, throws an exception if used.

inner_classes.name: CalculateFactory
inner_classes.description: Factory class to create instances of the Calculate operation from XML elements.

methods.name: Calculate
methods.description: Constructor. Initializes the operation based on XML configuration, defining sub-operations and type processing.
